title: Administrator
description:
Vital Human Resources are currently recruiting for an Administrator based in York, offering an excellent opportunity to work within the rail industry, supporting one of the UK's largest rail infrastructure organisations.

We are looking for an organised and proactive individual with strong administration skills to provide support to the Section Manager and wider team.

Main Responsibilities:
- Providing administrative support to the Section Manager and wider team.
- Managing staff rosters and timesheets.
- Maintaining accurate records, databases and filing systems.
- Opening and closing work orders.
- Supporting the Assessment in the Line (AIL) process.
- Maintaining confidential and safety-critical documentation.
- Coordinating general office administration.
- Supporting other Section Administrators when required.

Essential Skills & Experience:
- Previous clerical or administrative experience.
- Good knowledge of IT systems.
- Strong organisational and time-management skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication.
- Ability to work independently and use initiative.

Previous experience within the railway industry would be advantageous but is not essential.

title: Education Delivery Coordinator, Alternative Provision North Yorkshire (new Yorkshire office opening early 2027)
description:
Education Delivery Coordinator, Alternative Provision North Yorkshire (new Yorkshire office opening early 2027) £30,000 - £35,000 basic OTE £50,000 - £65,000 year one

Some children cannot thrive in mainstream school. At AP Education, named National Tutoring Company of the Year, more than 500 of them learn with us every day, and we are bringing that work to more young people across North Yorkshire with a new Yorkshire office opening in early 2027. If you come from teaching, tutoring, SEND or pastoral work, this role lets you keep shaping outcomes outside the classroom.

The role

You will coordinate bespoke tuition programmes for learners who cannot access mainstream education or need a more individual approach. You will be the link between Local Authorities, tutors and families, making sure every young person receives consistent, high-quality support.

What you will do
- Understand each learner's needs and make sure the provision we arrange meets them.
- Match tutors and education support professionals to learners, based on skills, experience and availability.
- Stay in regular contact with tutors and families, and visit settings and homes to review attendance, engagement and progress.
- Work with Local Authorities, schools, Virtual Schools and SEND teams.
- Spot challenges early and work with everyone involved to solve them.

Where you will work
- Three weeks of funded training at our head office in Harlow, Essex, to start. (accommodation will be provided)
- Home-based across York, Harrogate, Scarborough, Northallerton and the rest of North Yorkshire until the office opens, then based at our new Yorkshire office which opens in early 2027.
- Regular travel to schools, settings and learners' homes, with mileage included. You will report to the Education Manager.

What we are looking for

Essential:
- Experience in education, ideally Alternative Provision, SEND or SEMH.
- An understanding of the challenges facing children and young people who struggle to access mainstream education.
- Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to work with families, tutors and professionals.
- Self-discipline and the ability to work independently.
- A calm, solutions-focused approach to challenging situations.
- A full driving licence and access to a vehicle.

Desirable:
- Experience in recruitment, relationship management or a similar role.

Why AP Education

AP Education is the National Tutoring Company of the Year. More than 500 children who cannot access mainstream school learn with us every day. We are growing fast, and our new Yorkshire office opens in early 2027. Our culture is family first: demanding, but supportive and kind.
- £30,000 - £35,000 basic plus commission, with on-target earnings (OTE) of £50,000 - £65,000 in year one.
- Three weeks of funded training, then ongoing development.
- A structured career progression framework, with real room to move up as the new office grows.
- Benefits package including - private healthcare after 36 months service, gym membership, pension, mileage scheme, full equipment provided - laptop and phone etc.

How to apply

Please apply via this advert, or get in touch directly with our Head of People Jennie McElhatton at (url removed)

This role is subject to an enhanced DBS check. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people, and we welcome applications from all backgrounds.

title: Employment & Litigation Legal Assistant
description:
Legal Assistant - Employment & Litigation

Location: York (with occasional travel between offices)
Salary: Competitive + Benefits
Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

The Opportunity

An established and highly respected regional law firm is seeking a proactive and organised Legal Assistant to join its Employment & Litigation team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop their legal career within a supportive, professional environment. The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting fee earners, managing client onboarding, progressing legal matters, and ensuring excellent client service throughout the lifecycle of a case.

The role combines legal administration, compliance responsibilities and hands-on case support, making it ideal for an ambitious individual with previous legal experience or a strong interest in litigation and employment law.

Key Responsibilities
Client Onboarding & Matter Management
- Open and maintain client files using the firm's case management system.
- Create and manage matter records and ensure documentation is accurately recorded.
- Coordinate the issuance and return of client care documentation and engagement paperwork.
- Manage electronic signature processes and client onboarding administration.
- Act as a key point of contact for clients throughout the lifespan of a matter.

Compliance & Risk
- Conduct identity verification and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) checks.
- Maintain accurate compliance records and client documentation.
- Liaise with internal compliance teams regarding queries or potential concerns.
- Ensure client information is handled confidentially and in accordance with regulatory requirements.
- Support continuous improvement of processes and systems.

Litigation & Employment Support
- Assist fee earners in progressing a varied caseload.
- Draft legal correspondence and documentation under supervision.
- Organise and review client documents and case papers.
- Prepare bills, invoices and associated financial records.
- Undertake basic legal research and support case preparation activities.
- Ensure all work is completed in accordance with firm procedures and quality standards.

File Closure & Administration
- Coordinate file closure procedures and record maintenance.
- Ensure all compliance and financial matters are concluded appropriately.
- Support archiving and retrieval of both physical and electronic files.
- Assist with diary management, correspondence, filing and general administrative duties.
- Provide occasional reception cover when required.

About You

The successful candidate will possess:
- Previous experience within a law firm, legal support, compliance or professional services environment.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- High levels of attention to detail and accuracy.
- Experience using Microsoft Office, particularly Word and Excel.
- Confidence working with digital document management and case management systems.
- A client-focused approach with a professional and empathetic manner.
- The ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
- A proactive attitude and willingness to learn and develop professionally.

Desirable Experience
- Experience supporting Employment, Litigation or Dispute Resolution teams.
- Knowledge of AML and client onboarding procedures.
- Familiarity with legal document drafting and case administration.
- Experience of electronic case management systems.

What's On Offer?
- The opportunity to join a well-established and reputable regional law firm.
- Exposure to a broad range of Employment and Litigation matters.
- Supportive team environment and ongoing professional development.
- Genuine opportunities for progression and career growth.
- Competitive salary and benefits package.

To apply, please submit your CV for confidential consideration.

Search is an equal opportunities recruiter and we welcome applications from all suitably skilled or qualified applicants, regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/beliefs, sexual orientation or age.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
As a Finance Assistant in York, you will help keep day-to-day finance work organised within the Business Services sector. You will work as part of the Accounting & Finance department, helping the business maintain clear and accurate financial records.

Client Details

The organisation operates in the Business Services sector in York.

Description
- Process routine financial information accurately and keep records up to date.
- Maintain organised finance files and supporting documentation for daily transactions.
- Prepare information for the Accounting & Finance department to review and use.
- Check finance data for completeness and raise any missing information promptly.
- Respond to finance-related queries and provide clear updates to relevant colleagues.
- Help maintain accurate records that support smooth day-to-day business operations.
- Use finance systems and spreadsheets to enter, update and retrieve financial information.

Profile

A successful 'Finance Assistant' should have:
- Experience of handling financial data with care and accuracy.
- Ability to maintain organised records and supporting documentation.
- Confidence using spreadsheets and finance systems for routine tasks.
- Ability to check information carefully and identify missing details.
- Clear written and verbal communication for responding to finance queries.
- Ability to manage routine tasks and keep information up to date.

Job Offer
- Permanent Finance Assistant position based in York.
- Free Parking on-site
- Hybrid working included after initial training
- Full-time Opportunity
- Salary of 27,900 to 33,000 dependent on the level of experience.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.
